name: raptor
description: Turns everything your AI knows about you into a lean operation (agents, skills, memory, a map), then trims it every week.

interface.shortDescription: Organize your AI setup, then keep it lean.
interface.longDescription: Reads what your AI already knows about you (memory, session history, chat exports, rules) and builds one entry, agents with contracts, skills, memory, state and a map. Then trims it weekly: measures what loads at chat start, cleans junk, finds rules nobody follows, and proposes at most 5 cuts you approve.
